AGI EXT · PHNX-4289 · prototype v4

Project on the left, session on the right

What an agent made comes first now: its artifacts as real previews, and its pull requests as rich cards with checks, description and merge. Session rows get a third line of useful facts, and their state lives in the icon on the right.

tickets, PRs, ranker: captured 2026-10-08 session timeline, files, checklist: illustrative
Why the swap

Your editor already works this way

Conductor and Superset, the agent workspaces on your Mac, use the same three-part shape: the list of work on the left, the agent in the middle, and that one workspace's changes, checks and PR on the right.

LeftEvery workspace or session, grouped by status (needs input, running)
MiddleThe agent's terminal or chat
RightThis workspace's diff, checks and Create PR

So the left side gets the project and everything in it, and the right side gets one session in full, including its PRs. The right side follows the tab you're on, the same way Active Terminal does today.

I couldn't screenshot Superset or Cursor: adding them to the computer allowlist was blocked. The pattern above comes from their public docs.

Close-ups

The three pieces that changed

Session row: three lines

Before (AGI Menu today)
✳Finalize - Dev API!m2 · stalled 42m · I checked the tracker for exis…
After

Line 1 is the name, line 2 is what it last said or is asking, and line 3 is the facts you act on: where, how long, ticket, PR state, artifacts, files. The words "asks" and "stalled" are gone; the icon on the right says it (? asking you, ! stopped, a spinning ring while working).

Artifacts: see them, don't list them

Real files from this session. The newest gets a large preview, the rest are tiles; click any to open it big, then open the file or reveal it in Finder. Today's card shows 90 px tiles inside folder rows.

Pull request: the Menu's rich card

Real PR #3835: author, state, branch, check results with links, the size of the change, and the description rendered as formatted text, folded until you ask for all of it.

Prototype

Try it

Click a terminal tab, or a session on the left: the right side switches to that session. The right side now leads with what the session made: artifacts, then pull requests, then the request and its last steps. The "right sidebar" tab is this very session, with its real artifacts. On the "delete CLI copies" session, expand #3835, press "Finish CI" and watch it turn ready, then merge. Use the toggle to mirror the two sides.

Plan

Same engine, now feeding two panels

  1. CLI: agents projects home <name> --json

    Feeds the left panel and AGI Menu Home: cycle counts without closed states, milestone, joined work items, project PRs, sessions by state.

    Done when: one test suite pins the join; a warm read takes under 200 ms.
  2. CLI: the session row carries its PRs and related tickets

    The right panel already renders the session stream row. Add the session's PR list (checks, head commit) and its open related tickets to that row, so the extension never fetches them itself.

    Done when: the right panel shows PRs for the session with no extra call from the extension.
  3. AGI EXT: the left Project container

    Five sections, each a separate view you can hide. Clicking a session focuses its terminal tab.

    Done when: on zion, clicking a session on the left switches the right panel within a second.
  4. AGI EXT: grow Active Terminal into the full session panel

    Add the PR section (from the PR card in #104), the files-changed list, Resume when stopped, and related tickets.

    Done when: a PR going green animates in place, and merge confirms the head commit.
